subtitle: Lesson 22 · The Real Tradeoffs

eyebrow: Three different things, not three discount tiers

steps.label: Reserved / Reservation
steps.sub: commit to an instance type & region — no interruption risk

steps.label: Savings Plan
steps.sub: commit to a $/hr of compute — applies across instance types

steps.label: Spot / Azure Spot VM
steps.sub: deepest discount — provider can reclaim with short notice

code:
Reserved Instance / Reservation
  -> steady-state baseline, no planned retirement

Savings Plan
  -> compute that's steady in aggregate but
     shifts shape (resizing, replatforming, mixed fleets)

Spot / Azure Spot VM
  -> genuinely fault-tolerant only:
     stateless batch, queue-backed workers, CI/CD agents
  -> NEVER a stateful single-instance service
caption: A 2-minute eviction notice is a normal event for the right workload, an outage for the wrong one.

steps.label: 1. Right-size first
steps.sub: a commitment on an oversized instance locks in the waste

steps.label: 2-3. Reserved baseline, Savings Plan the rest
steps.sub: stable shape gets Reserved; shifting shape gets a Savings Plan

steps.label: 4. Spot layered on top
steps.sub: additional capacity for fault-tolerant work, never the only capacity
